## Problem
Thirteen of seventeen rows fell this run, and nothing separates 'the platform got worse' from 'the bar moved'. Four anchors carry stale hand-typed literals ($85 in BOTH cto and observability while the live AWS Budgets limit reads 215.0; 'cycle-6' in narrative while SSM /life-platform/experiment-cycle says 16; '89 pages' in designer while tests/qa_manifest.visual_pages() returns 92). Three qs extensions were written mid-run by the run that found their specimen (they map 1:1 onto QS-3/#3550, QS-1/#3511 and the refuted QS-2). And six clauses currently pass BY SILENCE: aiq's Day-4 spot-check on cycles that never reached Day 4; qs's lever clause graded against /api/protocols count=0; dataviz's live-encoding clause graded on Day 0 when the series are empty arrays; designer's Day-N-sparse clause, never once graded on a populated site; cpo's premiere verdict, never recorded; a11y's /data/training/ ledger whose cleanliness is Day-0 emptiness. #3603 freezes the wording; it does not derive the numbers, does not forbid a loosening, and does not give the grader a third verdict.

It closes no single `to_full_A` row — it is the ladder's **precondition**. Every lens's `after_filed` grade in Part 4 is measured against an anchor that four stale literals and three mid-run extensions moved inside the run that graded it, and six clauses passed by silence. Lenses moved: **all 17**.

**Price:** FREE

Extends #3603 (which freezes the wording): #3603 does not derive the numbers, does not forbid a loosening, and gives the grader no third verdict. This story adds the sealed artifact, the placeholders, the tightening-only diff and UNOBSERVED.

Filed from **Part 4 ("From A- to A")** of the forensic root-cause analysis of the 2026-09-05 `/review full` baseline — `docs/reviews/FORENSIC_RCA_2026-09-05.md`. This batch is the residue layer: the `every`-quantified anchor clauses whose SETS nobody enumerated, plus the per-lens residue. The 99 findings are in `docs/reviews/FULLREVIEW_2026-09-05.md` (epics #3489–#3498, stories #3499–#3571); the process layer is epics #3592/#3593 (stories #3594–#3603).

## Outcome
**Operator** — 'All A' becomes a target that can be hit, because the target stops moving and silence stops counting as a pass.

## Acceptance
- [ ] docs/reviews/anchors/ANCHORS.json committed on main with a docs/reviews/anchors/ANCHORS.sha256.json sibling (the prereg seal's content-addressed shape, per the #3483 lesson); one record per lens {lens, anchors A..F, frozen_at, frozen_by, supersedes_sha, derived_fields[], proposed_extensions[]}; the review skill loads it and prints its hash in the report header
- [ ] Every numeric or enumerable literal inside an anchor is a ${…} placeholder resolved at grading time — ${ceiling} from the value cdk/stacks/core_stack.py parses out of the governor source at synth time, ${cycle} from SSM, ${page_count} from qa_manifest.visual_pages(), ${min_n}/${distinct_margin} from voice_fidelity_core, ${lane_budget} from deploy/github_posture.json — and a bare literal reds the freeze test
- [ ] An extension proposed during a run is written to proposed_extensions[] with its authoring run id and does NOT bind that run's grade; the run reports TWO grades per lens (frozen, and frozen+proposed) and names which clause moved the row
- [ ] The freeze test diffs the new file against the previous sha and REDS on any clause weakened, removed, or with a relaxed evidence requirement; a deliberate loosening needs an owner-signed dated line in the file and appears in the review header
- [ ] Every clause resolves to MET (with a cited file:line/URL/query result), FAILED (cited), or UNOBSERVED (with the reason it could not be sampled) — and a lens with ANY UNOBSERVED clause cannot be graded A
- [ ] tests/test_anchor_freeze.py carries three planted must-fails plus a positive control: (1) a weakened clause reds the diff / a tightened one passes; (2) a fixture carrying '$85' or 'cycle-6' or '89 pages' as a literal reds / the placeholder form passes; (3) a lens record with deliberately absent evidence returns UNOBSERVED, never MET; (4) mutating ANCHORS.json without regenerating the sibling reds, and the review refuses to run against an unsealed anchor file
- [ ] The FIRST frozen version already carries the tightenings this run proposed: the CloudWatch suppressor registry (cto/observability), the derived contrast foreground set (a11y), the (cycle_day × hook × artifact) matrix (cpo), the carry-across-reset rule for bets (qs), the split of growth's fused 'real AND measured' clause, and the priced-observability-estate clause (cost). narrative's 'reset seams are invisible to a binge reader' is left EXACTLY as written — every available rewording lowers it

**Score:** P1 · Impact 4 × Confidence 1.0 / Effort M(2) = 2.00 → Next
**Epic:** #3593

## Problem
Five uncovered clauses across the two ops lenses. (a) 'Every watchdog's producer is verified actually emitting' — 52 of 82 scheduled Lambdas are dated EXEMPT waivers whose test guards date and reason LENGTH, never the reason's truth (the canary's '4x-daily' waiver is stale at ~119 runs/day across two rules and backs six notBreaching alarms); #3506 retires one family and ratchets the fraction, and a ratchet is a promise about direction, not a satisfaction of 'every'. The denominator is also wrong: it enumerates SCHEDULED functions, so an event-driven observer is invisible by construction — which is how BoardQualityGateVerdict{Surface=board_ask} (15 verdicts on 09-01, 3 on 09-03) ended up with no silence detector. (b) 'Liveness sensors are capability-verified (not just IAM-parity-verified)' — the anchor names #3596 as insufficient by its own wording, and post_cdk_smoke.sh:8-11 tests TLS, Lambda error state and an MCP ping while no sensor exercises the write it exists to perform (OBS-1/#3502 ran 30+ days green on a swallowed AccessDenied; #3563's PutItem was denied 49 days behind a green /api/status). (c) token-alarm-genesis-window-active has been in ALARM 4.2 days DOING ITS JOB — a CloudWatch composite ALARM_RULE can reference only alarm STATES, so a suppressor flag must BE an alarm and must be LIT, and both consuming composites depend on it; the sweeps have acked it 7× as an incident. (d) Nothing reds on alarm AGE: freshness-interior-gap is at 5.1 days, already past the anchor's 72h. (e) needs-human lines have no id, no first_seen, no renewal count and no terminal state — freshness-interior-gap was re-handed-off verbatim 9 times about one unchanged state.

**Ladder rows this closes** (Part 4's `to_full_A` register, quoted verbatim):

*observability — now B+ (was A-); Part 4 ceiling: A- — two clauses cannot be settled by work: the suppressor flag is unsatisfiable against the CloudWatch product, and 'paged for what matters and only that' is a taste verdict no artifact adjudicates. This is also the ONE place across 17 lenses where a dollar buys a grade step, and it is 43 cents — the next $24.57 buys a grade LOSS.*

- **observability ROW1** — 'Every watchdog's producer is verified actually emitting': 52 of 82 scheduled Lambdas are dated EXEMPT waivers whose test guards date + reason LENGTH, never the reason's truth (the canary's '4x-daily' waiver is stale at ~119 runs/day and backs six notBreaching alarms). #3506 retires ONE family and ratchets the fraction; a ratchet is a promise about direction, not a satisfaction of 'every'. Demote: 90 days zero findings AND EXEMPT at zero → fold into tests/test_heartbeat_completeness.py as a static assertion
- **observability ROW2** — Swap the census denominator from 'scheduled Lambdas' to the EMF namespace ledger (deploy/emf_namespace_ledger.py) — an event-driven observer is invisible to the CDK-schedule enumeration by construction, which is how BoardQualityGateVerdict{Surface=board_ask} ended up with no silence detector after #3413/#3414. PRICE: FREE (denominator swap; the extra metrics are under a cent inside the $0.43)
- **observability ROW3** — 'Nothing permanently red or structurally unclearable' — same CloudWatch constraint as cto: token-alarm-genesis-window-active has been lit 4.2 days DOING ITS JOB and the sweeps have acked it 7× as an incident. - **observability ROW4** — The extension's terminal-condition requirement for hand-offs: needs-human lines have no id, no first_seen, no renewal count and no terminal state — freshness-interior-gap was re-handed-off 9 times verbatim about one unchanged state. #3508 fixed one PRODUCER; #3597 fixes documents, not runtime lines. The store already exists (s3://…/remediation-log/YYYY/MM/DD/HHMMSS.json). PRICE: FREE
- **observability ROW5** — 'Paged for what matters and only that': 116 metric + 2 composite alarms live; routing digest 89 / paging 2 / urgent 25. Count pages sent, pages acted on, and every zero-page alarm as a DEMOTE candidate. PRICE: FREE (the counting) + OWNER (every demote ruling is `owner_decision_needed` — and, honestly, the verdict itself is your judgment about your own attention; no instrument makes it)

*cto — now B+ (was A-); Part 4 ceiling: A- — one clause is unachievable by construction against the CloudWatch product, so a literal A requires an anchor amendment before any work can qualify. And on this lens money is INVERTED: the anchor prices added standing machinery as a negative, so a $25/mo lift lowers the grade.*

- **cto ROW1** — 'Liveness sensors are capability-verified (NOT just IAM-parity-verified) after deploy' — the anchor names the filed thing (#3596) as insufficient by its own wording. post_cdk_smoke.sh tests TLS, Lambda error state and an MCP ping; no sensor exercises the write it exists to perform (how OBS-1/#3502 ran 30+ days green on AccessDenied and #3563's PutItem was denied 49 days behind a green /api/status). PRICE: FREE (~30 `--self-test` branches + one smoke leg + one enumeration) + RENT $0.0001/mo (600 invokes/mo at $0.20/1M) — demote after 90 days of zero failures with #3596 green
- **cto ROW3** — A 72h alarm-age dead-man. Live right now: freshness-interior-gap in ALARM 5.1 days (since 2026-08-31T08:02 PT), qa-smoke-failures 2.0d, qa-smoke-warnings 1.0d. #3501 fixes citation cause/timestamp; nothing reds on AGE. scripts/check_alarm_citations.py already calls describe_alarms. PRICE: FREE (one age predicate + a planted-stale-citation control) + OWNER (rule on freshness-interior-gap: does an acknowledged-unfillable historical gap suppress the alarm, or does #2643's absence marker land instead?)
- **cto ROW4** — token-alarm-genesis-window-active is RED BY CONSTRUCTION and no work, money, time or owner act can clear it: a CloudWatch composite ALARM_RULE can reference only alarm STATES, so a suppressor flag must BE an alarm and must be LIT to suppress. **Rent — $0.43/mo, priced and demotable (ADR-103/144):**
- **Producer census dead-man — $0.43/mo.** Arithmetic: 81 scheduled functions × 1 daily `GetMetricData` call × 30 days = 2,430 metrics requested at $0.01/1,000 = **$0.024**; + 1 custom verdict metric **$0.30**; + 1 standard-resolution alarm **$0.10**. No new schedule and no new Lambda — it rides `qa_smoke` or the drift sentinel. The per-producer alternative (~$20.80/mo) would breach the cto anchor's "no added standing machinery" clause instead.
- **Demote trigger:** 90 consecutive days with zero silent-producer findings AND the EXEMPT fraction at zero → fold into `tests/test_heartbeat_completeness.py` as a static assertion, delete the alarm and the custom metric.
- **Capability self-tests — $0.0001/mo.** 30 sensor invokes × ~20 deploys = 600 Lambda requests at $0.20/1M = $0.00012; GB-seconds in the noise. No new series, no new alarm — it rides the smoke's exit code. **Demote trigger:** 90 consecutive days with zero self-test failures AND #3596's IAM-parity role family green in premerge → fold the self-test into each sensor's normal run and delete the smoke leg.
- Everything else in this story is FREE. **A PROPORTIONALITY row with `demote_when` is required at merge** (#3597's shape).
- This is the single dollar-priced grade step anywhere in the 17 lenses, and it is 43 cents.

Extends #3506 (which ratchets the EXEMPT fraction — a promise about direction, not a satisfaction of 'every'), #3596 (named insufficient by the cto anchor's own wording), #3501 and #3504 (citation cause; the freshness alarm's own ruling is item 7 of the owner issue #3606), #3502 and #3503.

The 99 findings are in `docs/reviews/FULLREVIEW_2026-09-05.md` (epics #3489–#3498, stories #3499–#3571); the process layer is epics #3592/#3593 (stories #3594–#3603).

## Outcome

## Acceptance
- [ ] One census leg (riding qa_smoke or the drift sentinel, no new schedule) reads AWS/Lambda Invocations for every emitter in deploy/emf_namespace_ledger.py — NOT the CDK schedule list — compares each against its registry cadence, and reds on any silent past its stale window; a planted silent producer makes it fail; the EXEMPT fraction goes to zero rather than being ratcheted

- [ ] A declared suppressor registry: each member names the composite(s) whose ALARM_RULE consumes it, carries a window with a stated end condition, and is covered by a dead-man that reds past that window; the ack and escalation sweeps exclude members by TYPE, never by name
- [ ] scripts/check_alarm_citations.py gains an AGE predicate (>72h with a citation whose timestamp does not post-date the StateTransitionedTimestamp) plus a planted-stale-citation must-fail control; the describe_alarms call it needs is already there

- [ ] The monthly close prints pages-sent, pages-acted-on and the ratio, and lists every alarm with zero true pages in 90 days as a DEMOTE candidate awaiting the owner's ruling

**Score:** P1 · Impact 4 × Confidence 1.0 / Effort L(4) = 1.00 → Later

## Problem
Three clauses across cpo and narrative have no instrument over their SET, plus one query bug that looks like a time cost and is not. (a) There is no hook registry and no per-cycle-day liveness matrix: qa_smoke_lambda.py:543 check_predict_week_freshness() is the only per-hook probe, ask-the-board is probed only by the 3×/week AI canary, chronicle/podcast cadence by nothing, and the extension's five downstream artifacts (permalink, manifest, RECAP#latest, share-kit, onboarding email) are each checked, when at all, by a different one-off. (b) 'No page contradicts another page's account of the same week' has no instrument at all — every contradiction found this run (#3518, #3526, #3520, #3521, #3515) was a human reading pages side by side, and each fix lands on its specimen. The absence half is the same: #3516/#3518 fix two narrating surfaces while agreement on a paused source's DURATION and CAUSE across the brief, the coach summary, /api/status, /method/pipeline/ and the freshness page is unguarded. (c) /api/voice_fidelity reads `insufficient_data` for EVERY coach at n=3 against MIN_N_FOR_VERDICT=6, while the scoreboard's 'latest' reads n=20/75%/distinct — because voice_fidelity_harness._sample_recent_outputs wraps its query in with_phase_filter() over COACH#{id}/OUTPUT#, which phase_taxonomy.py:384 classifies EXPERIMENT_SCOPED, so a harness whose own docstring (:27-32) declares it CROSS_PHASE can only sample the current cycle — and Limit=8 is applied BEFORE the FilterExpression, so if the 8 newest rows are archived the query returns zero. Twelve cycles of coach prose are sitting tombstoned (restart_intelligence_wipe.py:339 stamps, it does not delete), invisible to the one instrument the narrative anchor names.

**Ladder rows this closes** (Part 4's `to_full_A` register, quoted verbatim):

*cpo — now B- (was B+); Part 4 ceiling: A- — the two hardest clauses (a hook alive on Day 4, an instrument that has graded whether coaching moved behaviour) both need a cycle that outlives a 7-day window, and only you can set that. $25/mo of per-hook series and daily vision runs would move detection latency 24h → 1h and the grade by zero.*

- **cpo ROW1** — There is no hook registry and no per-cycle-day liveness matrix. qa_smoke_lambda.py:543 check_predict_week_freshness() is the ONLY per-hook probe; ask-the-board is probed only by the 3×/week AI canary; chronicle/podcast cadence by nothing; the extension's five downstream artifacts (permalink, manifest, RECAP#latest, share-kit, onboarding email) are each checked by a different one-off. PRICE: FREE (a committed registry + one leg in qa_smoke's existing invocation, ~36 key-bounded reads/night, a MISSING cell is a red)
- **cpo ROW2** — 11 pages advertise a podcast feed with ZERO episodes: site/story/broadcast/index.html:30 and 10 siblings carry `<link rel=alternate … /podcast/feed.xml>`; the feed is 200/593 bytes with a channel and no `<item>`, so it unfurls as real in every podcast client. PRICE: FREE for the honest-absence path (gate the alternate-link emission in scripts/v4_chrome.py on a non-empty feed) OR RENT $0.30-0.60/mo to make it live (~4 installments × ~1,200 words TTS; demote at zero trailing-90d requests) — the grade is identical either way, so this is an OWNER product call
- **cpo ROW5** — 'Each of the 4 audiences finds its surface within one click of Home' has no derivation gate — test_wayfinding.py enforces the footer, test_site_orphans.py enforces reachability, nothing maps audience → surface → click depth. PRICE: FREE (parse the audience table out of PLATFORM_NORTH_STAR.md:48-56 and assert a direct href from site/index.html)

*narrative — now C+ (was B+); Part 4 ceiling: B+ without a cadence ruling, A- with the sampler fix — this is the lens where the anchor and the operating cadence are in open contradiction, and no amount of free work resolves it. It is also the lens with the single highest return on the one decision only you can make.*

- **narrative ROW1** — 'Each coach is distinguishable blind' is FALSE per-coach and the reason is a fixable coupling, not time: the scoreboard's 'latest' reads n=20 / 75% / verdict distinct, while /api/voice_fidelity says `insufficient_data` for EVERY coach at n=3 against MIN_N_FOR_VERDICT=6. Cause: voice_fidelity_harness._sample_recent_outputs wraps its query in with_phase_filter() over COACH#{id}/OUTPUT#, which phase_taxonomy.py:384 classifies EXPERIMENT_SCOPED — so a harness whose own docstring declares it CROSS_PHASE can only see the current cycle, and Limit=8 is applied BEFORE the filter. Twelve cycles of coach prose are sitting tombstoned, not deleted. PRICE: FREE (drop the filter, raise the limit, plant the day-after-genesis negative control) + TIME ≤31 days after the fix, or RENT $0.46/mo to go weekly and get there in ~2 weeks (48 Haiku calls/run × $0.0022; demote at n≥12 and a stable verdict) — this converts an apparent ~90-day ceiling into roughly one run
- **narrative ROW2** — 'No page contradicts another page's account of the same week' has no instrument over the SET — every contradiction (#3518, #3526, #3520, #3521, #3515) was found by a human reading pages side by side, and each fix lands on its specimen (#3594's diagnosis, exactly). PRICE: FREE (a registry of every surface that narrates a week + a nightly agreement gate on the facts they all restate: cycle, day_n, week label, baseline weight, current weight, named plan figures)
- **narrative ROW3** — The 2026-08-09 extension's 'one absence is one story' is only partly covered: #3516/#3518 fix two narrating surfaces; agreement on DURATION and CAUSE across the brief, the coach summary, /api/status, /method/pipeline/ and the freshness page is unguarded, and /api/journey serves weekly_rate_lbs 0.0 from a zero-observation span. PRICE: FREE (one more fact family in the same comparison leg)

**Lenses moved:** cpo, narrative, aiq.

**Price:** FREE (rides qa_smoke's existing nightly invocation and the existing FailCount alarm; zero new CloudWatch series). Optional RENT $0.46/mo to run voice-fidelity weekly instead of monthly — 48 Haiku calls/run × $0.0022 — demote once every coach carries n ≥ 12 with a stable verdict across two runs. Do NOT buy it before the sampler fix lands: more runs against a phase-filtered query buys more runs of the same starvation.

Extends #3512/#3485 (the chronicle resurrection specimens), #3516/#3518 (two narrating surfaces each fixed on its specimen) and #3520/#3521/#3526/#3515. **Sequencing: this rides the SAME nightly qa_smoke invocation as #3600's wiped-cycle census — one leg, two walks. Land it into #3600's leg rather than beside it.**

## Outcome
**Reddit newcomers** — Two 'every surface' clauses acquire a registry and a nightly verdict, and an apparent ~90-day TIME cost on per-coach voice verdicts collapses to roughly one run.

## Acceptance
- [ ] A committed hooks registry enumerating {predict-the-week, ask-the-board, chronicle, podcast, votes, board-ask} × their five downstream artifacts; one leg in qa_smoke's existing invocation walks it (~36 key-bounded reads/night) and writes a (cycle_day × hook × artifact) → alive|honestly-absent row; a MISSING cell is a RED, not a shrug; the registry count may only grow and a hook added to site/ without a row reds a derivation test

- [ ] The same comparison covers the absence facts: every surface narrating a paused/lagging source renders duration and cause derived from source_registry's own facets, and any consumer showing a rate also shows its n and provisional flag
- [ ] voice_fidelity_harness._sample_recent_outputs drops with_phase_filter (or passes include_pilot=True) and raises Limit so post-filter starvation cannot happen, since the scoreboard is already declared CROSS_PHASE; a NEGATIVE CONTROL asserts a run on the day AFTER a genesis returns SAMPLES_PER_COACH for every coach, or reds; the harness is invoked once against the archive to backfill
- [ ] 11 pages stop advertising an empty podcast feed: scripts/v4_chrome.py gates the `<link rel=alternate … /podcast/feed.xml>` emission on a non-empty feed and the hook is registered honestly-absent (or the owner elects the TTS build instead — the clause is satisfied either way)
- [ ] The audience→surface click-depth gate: parse the four audiences out of docs/PLATFORM_NORTH_STAR.md:48-56, resolve each named surface, assert a direct href from site/index.html; a redesign that moves a surface to depth 2 reds it

**Score:** P1 · Impact 4 × Confidence 1.0 / Effort L(4) = 1.00 → Now

## Problem
Both front-end anchors say 'automated check, not hand-written comments' and both are enforced by hand-typed lists. tests/test_token_contrast.py:99-110 PAIRS holds five foregrounds while a derivation over site/assets/**/*.{css,js} finds 20 tokens used as text — and --alert (#1222), coach accents (#2919/#3057), --pillar-* (#3545) and now --tier-accent are four specimens of ONE class, each fixed by lengthening the list. --tier-accent is the unfiled fourth: tokens.css:1839-1843 defines it per [data-tier] inside the dark root only, evidence.css:716/:788 render it as text, and on light --page #F4EFE4 it computes 2.23 (discipline), 2.13 (mastery), 1.75 (elite) — a live AA failure invisible to axe until the character tier advances. scripts/check_css_tokens.py runs four checks and NONE is spacing or radius, though DESIGN_SYSTEM_V5.md:131 forbids hardcoding them: 276 raw declarations live in the swept sheets (story 64, evidence 80, cockpit 26, mind 29, subscribe 1, tokens 76). Single-ember has no gate that can see a second accent, because tokens.css — where one would be BORN — is 'the allowlist, never swept' (:104-105). The ~20 residual light-theme pages carrying 366 desktop + 277 mobile baselined contrast nodes (led by /data/labs/ at 52) are named by no filed issue and are permanently invisible to a gate that only forbids NEW serious violations. And two whole a11y clauses have no runtime gate: keyboard-operability is true today only by careful hand-authoring across 61 non-button click sites, and 'reduced-motion is honored' is verified by a STRING SEARCH (test_site_a11y_landmarks.py:92 asserts the literal appears in tokens.css) — the exact 'hand-written comments' form the anchor rejects for contrast.

**Ladder rows this closes** (Part 4's `to_full_A` register, quoted verbatim):

*a11y — now B+ (was A-); Part 4 ceiling: A- without one owner act, A with it — every technical gap is free session labour, but the tap-target clause needs a decision only you can make and the both-themes-gating clause needs the #1991 posture either reversed or written into the anchor. The one genuine $29/mo purchase (a real assistive-technology lab) buys quality the anchor does not measure.*

- **a11y ROW1** — ~20 light-theme pages carry baselined SERIOUS contrast that no filed issue names: pages_light holds 24 entries / 366 nodes and pages_light_mobile 18 / 277; #3544/#3545 reach 218 and 219, leaving /data/labs/ 52, /coaching/ 9, /coaching/read/ 9, /data/habits/ 9, /method/board/ 8 and fifteen more. The gate only forbids a NEW serious violation, so this debt is permanently invisible to it. PRICE: FREE (~1h to classify with one `--color-scheme light` run, then 2-3 class fixes covering all 20; arm #3548's must-name-an-issue rule AFTER the fixes so it does not simply mint 20 trackers)
- **a11y ROW2** — --tier-accent is used as TEXT (evidence.css:716, :788) and has no light-theme override — the FOURTH specimen of the class #3545 fixes as its third, and unfiled. Arithmetic on light --page #F4EFE4: discipline 2.23, mastery 2.13, elite 1.75 (all pass in dark at 7.65-9.75). Invisible to axe until the character tier advances past momentum. PRICE: FREE (five light values) + TIME (it only appears in a live run once the tier advances — another defect a weekly reset keeps latent)
- **a11y ROW3** — The token-contrast check's foreground set is a HAND-TYPED list of five (test_token_contrast.py:99-110) while 20 distinct tokens are used as text — and --alert (#1222), coach accents (#2919/#3057), pillars (#3545) and tier-accent are four specimens of one class, each fixed by lengthening the list. The anchor's own words are 'an automated token-contrast check, not hand-written comments'. PRICE: FREE (derive the foreground set from usage with aliases resolved, keep #3545's fail-on-missing-light-block for the whole set, plus a reasoned exemption registry)
- **a11y ROW4** — 'Every interactive widget is keyboard-operable with visible focus' has NO gate — it is true today by careful hand-authoring across provenance_popover.js, coach_popover.js, tabs.js and motion.js:160-166, with 61 non-button click sites and nothing that would notice a regression. PRICE: FREE (a Playwright keyboard walk over the registry with a strip-tabindex control; ~1-2 min CI)
- **a11y ROW5** — 'Reduced-motion is honored' is verified only by a STRING SEARCH (test_site_a11y_landmarks.py:92 asserts the literal appears in tokens.css) — the 'hand-written comments' form the anchor rejects for contrast, applied to motion. PRICE: FREE (a reduced_motion='reduce' context + getAnimations() sweep with a remove-one-guard control)

*designer — now B+ (was A-); Part 4 ceiling: A- on any Day-0 run, A on a run at Day ≥14 — everything except the sparse-state clause is free labour a session can finish. The only $25/mo purchase that would raise the ceiling ABOVE the anchor is a real-device rendering lab (~$29/mo), which the anchor does not ask for.*

- **designer ROW1** — 'Spacing' is named in the first clause and has NO gate of any kind: check_css_tokens.py runs exactly four checks (raw font-size, undefined var, raw hex, breakpoints) and none is spacing or radius, while 276 raw padding/margin/gap/border-radius literals live in the swept sheets (story 64, evidence 80, cockpit 26, mind 29, subscribe 1, tokens 76). PRICE: FREE (an `sp-ok:`/`radius-ok:` sanction grammar mirroring the existing `fs-ok:` machinery + a planted `gap: 13px` control + a shrink-only sanctioned count; ~2-3h of triage)
- **designer ROW2** — 'Single-ember discipline enforced by a gate' has no gate that can see a second accent: the only mechanism is the raw-hex sweep, and tokens.css is 'the allowlist — never swept' (:104-105), so `--accent-teal: #0ea5e9` added to tokens.css and used via var() passes everything. PRICE: FREE (derive the accent set from USAGE and assert membership in an explicit registry {ember, alert, coach, pillar-*, tier-accent})
- **designer ROW3** — The measured floor stops short of the registry the extension names: TEXT_FLOOR_PAGES is 3 pages today and #3543 widens it to tier-1/2 (63 of 92), leaving 29 tier-3/4 pages never measured for HTML text at 390/1280. PRICE: FREE (~1h triage + ~2 min CI wall-clock; $0 — the repo is PUBLIC so standard runners are free, and visual_qa's own docstring prices the browser sweep at $0)

**Lenses moved:** a11y, designer.

**Price:** FREE ($0 — axe is vendored, Playwright is a dev dep, and Actions standard runners are free on this PUBLIC repo; ~4-5 min added CI wall-clock)

Extends #3545 (whose primitive this generalises — pillars were the third specimen of one class; `--tier-accent` is the unfiled FOURTH), #3543 (TEXT_FLOOR_PAGES → the full `qa_manifest.visual_pages()` set), #3544, #3546 and #3548 (whose must-name-an-issue rule is armed AFTER the light-theme fixes so it does not mint 20 trackers). The #1991 both-themes posture (a11y ROW8) is item 11 of the consolidated owner issue #3606; the tap-target ruling (a11y ROW7) is item 12.

Filed from **Part 4 ("From A- to A")** of the forensic root-cause analysis of the 2026-09-05 `/review full` baseline — `docs/reviews/FORENSIC_RCA_2026-09-05.md`. This batch is the residue layer: the `every`-quantified anchor clauses whose SETS nobody enumerated, plus the per-lens residue. The 99 findings are in `docs/reviews/FULLREVIEW_2026-09-05.md` (epics #3489–#3498, stories #3499–#3571); the process layer is epics #3592/#3593 (stories #3594–#3603).

## Outcome
**Friends & family** — Four token gates stop being maintained lists, two runtime clauses acquire an actual measurement, and the light theme stops carrying invisible debt.

## Acceptance
- [ ] test_token_contrast.py's PAIRS is DERIVED: foregrounds = every token used as a text colour anywhere in site/assets/** with aliases resolved, backgrounds = the surfaces those selectors sit on; a token used as text with no light-block definition FAILS rather than falling through to the dark value (#3545's primitive generalised); an explicit reasoned exemption registry replaces the list; planting `--accent-x: #999` on a text selector reds it
- [ ] --tier-accent gains light values for all five tiers at ≥4.5:1 on --page and --surface, with a must-fail control using the current #D4B45C against the light page
- [ ] check_css_tokens.py gains an `sp-ok:`/`radius-ok:` sanction grammar mirroring the existing fs-ok:/hex-ok: machinery and sweeps padding/margin/gap/row-gap/column-gap/border-radius over all sheets AND the generated <style> blocks; the 276 literals are triaged (lifted to --sp-*/radius tokens, or sanctioned with a self-contained reason or an open #N); unsanctioned count zero, sanctioned count a shrink-only ratchet; a planted `gap: 13px` reds it
- [ ] A registry of the accent channel derived from usage (every color/fill/stroke/border-color var that is not ink*/page/surface/rule*) asserts membership in {ember(+soft/line/wash), alert(+wash/line), coach, pillar-*, tier-accent}; a new member reds the gate — closing the tokens.css blind spot rather than tolerating it
- [ ] One `--color-scheme light` axe pass classifies the ~20 residual pages (expect 2-3 classes), the classes are fixed, and pages_light + pages_light_mobile carry zero color-contrast entries; #3548's must-name-an-issue rule is armed AFTER the fixes so it does not mint 20 trackers
- [ ] TEXT_FLOOR_PAGES is replaced by qa_manifest.visual_pages() with no tier filter (92 pages, not 3 or 63), armed only once the set measures clean per the 2026-07-17 rule at visual_qa.py:585-587; a planted 0.6rem rule on a tier-3 page reds the sweep
- [ ] A Playwright keyboard walk over the registry: Tab through every focusable, assert the computed outline/box-shadow differs from the unfocused state, assert every click-listener element is in the tab order or has a keyboard equivalent; stripping tabindex from tabs.js in a fixture must produce a finding
- [ ] A reduced_motion='reduce' context over tier-1/2 asserts no element reports a running animation or non-instant transition after load and after scroll; removing one no-preference guard must produce a finding

**Score:** P2 · Impact 3 × Confidence 1.0 / Effort L(4) = 0.75 → Later
**Epic:** #3494

body:
## Problem
Two lenses, one record. (a) 329 live rows carry `tombstoned_reason = experiment_restart_2026-09-04` while `closing_cycle_for_genesis('2026-09-04', CYCLE_GENESES)` returns None, because the Session U re-anchor corrected lambdas/web/site_api_data.py:103-124 in place to 16:'2026-09-05' — and restart_intelligence_wipe.py:344,366 writes the tombstone with if_not_exists PRECISELY so a later reset preserves provenance, which is exactly why the in-place correction cannot reach them. Nothing filed proves a double reset. (b) experiment_gates.py's eight module-level thresholds (CORRELATION_MIN_N=10 :17, HYPOTHESIS_MIN_DATA_DAYS=10 :27, MIN_SAMPLE_DAYS_FOR_CHECK=7 :29, COUPLING_MIN_N=6 :33, FELT_CALIBRATION_MIN_WEEKS=5 :64 …) carry prose comments naming an internal review persona or a method — neither a personal derivation nor a labelled population constant — and correlation_gates() serves min_n/interp_n/current_n with no provenance at all; #3552 covers only the two hypothesis min_effects. (c) The offline citation half gates every commit (test_citation_resolution_1892.py:79-85), while scripts/verify_citations.py and the `integration`-marked network test at :171-177 appear in ZERO workflows — so a retraction or PMID reassignment across 103 PubMed links + 3 DOIs is invisible until a human runs it. (d) /api/protocols returns count=0 and the DDB query returns 0 items, so 'every protocol lever states the data it targets and the hypothesis that spawned it' passes VACUOUSLY at every grading moment a reviewer will occupy, and the 24-key schema has no hypothesis-linkage field (the S3 fallback's `origin` is a literature string). (e) #3549 bounds the survival number honestly and leaves the page leading with a 30-day horizon no cycle has reached since 2026-06-14.

**Ladder rows this closes** (Part 4's `to_full_A` register, quoted verbatim):

*qs — now B- (grader B, verifier B-, dissent recorded); Part 4 ceiling: A- — three of the five A clauses (bets graded, thresholds from personal variance, protocol levers) are measurements a 5-day cycle and a 14-in-65-days weigh-in record cannot produce, and no amount of code closes that. $25/mo buys ~83 metric series; this lens has no gap a series would close.*

- **qs ROW2** — ZERO protocol levers exist and the schema has no field for the hypothesis that spawned one: /api/protocols returns count=0 and the DDB query returns 0 items, so the clause passes VACUOUSLY at every grading moment a reviewer will ever occupy; the S3 fallback's `origin` is a literature string, not a hypothesis link. PRICE: FREE (a `spawned_by` field + a write-time refusal + a contract test) + OWNER (the phase_taxonomy class ruling: are levers experiment_scoped, as today, or a cross_phase registry?) + TIME (≥17 days if they stay scoped: HYPOTHESIS_MIN_DATA_DAYS=10 + MIN_SAMPLE_DAYS_FOR_CHECK=7)
- **qs ROW3** — The gate registry's own thresholds carry NO provenance — eight module-level values in experiment_gates.py (CORRELATION_MIN_N=10, HYPOTHESIS_MIN_DATA_DAYS=10, COUPLING_MIN_N=6, FELT_CALIBRATION_MIN_WEEKS=5 …) carry prose comments naming an internal persona or a method, which is neither a personal derivation nor a labelled population constant, and correlation_gates() serves them with no provenance at all. #3552 covers the two hypothesis min_effects only. PRICE: FREE (a {value, kind, source} facet + a completeness test + payload passthrough)
- **qs ROW4** — Citation resolvability has an instrument that runs ON DEMAND ONLY: the offline half gates every commit, but scripts/verify_citations.py and the `integration`-marked network test appear in ZERO workflows, so a retraction or PMID reassignment across 103 PubMed + 3 DOIs is invisible until a human runs it. PRICE: FREE ($0 on a public repo; $0.0006/mo as a nightly qa_smoke leg) — demote to quarterly after 12 monthly runs with zero drifts
- **qs ROW7** — The survival headline's horizon has ZERO observations at 30 days and cannot acquire one at this cadence. #3549 makes the number honest (bounded to ≈5.9%) and leaves an n=0 headline. PRICE: FREE (derive the reported horizon from max(window_days) over priors) + TIME (30 continuous days for one observation)

*data-architect — now B (was B+); Part 4 ceiling: A- — the only thing that is not code is one attended DynamoDB reconcile; with it this lens reaches a full A at ANY cadence. The honest asymmetry: at 4.6-day cycles it falls back out of A within a cycle or two because every reset is a fresh chance for a writer to escape the census.*

- **data-architect ROW1** — The idempotency clause is FALSE in live data: 329 rows carry `tombstoned_reason = experiment_restart_2026-09-04`, and `closing_cycle_for_genesis('2026-09-04', CYCLE_GENESES)` returns None because the Session U re-anchor corrected the registry IN PLACE to 16:'2026-09-05'. The rows are cycle=15, phase=pilot (physical_coach 45, sleep_coach 45, mind_coach 36 …). deploy/restart_intelligence_wipe.py:344,366 writes with if_not_exists precisely so a LATER reset preserves provenance — which is exactly why the in-place correction cannot reach them. PRICE: FREE (an ABANDONED_GENESES alias map beside CYCLE_GENESES carrying the dated reason, a resolver change, a census assertion that is RED today on 329 rows, and a double-reset fixture harness). Re-putting the 329 reason strings would be OWNER and strictly worse — it destroys the record that the Friday genesis was written

**Lenses moved:** qs, data-architect.

**Price:** FREE (the citation cron is $0 on a public repo, or $0.0006/mo as a nightly qa_smoke leg — demote to quarterly after 12 monthly runs with zero drifts). The protocol-lever phase class is gate:owner; the ~88-row live reconcile is a single attended act in the owner issue #3606.

Extends #3552 (which covers only the two hypothesis `min_effect`s, not the eight gate thresholds), #3549 (which bounds the survival number and leaves an n=0 30-day headline), #3511/#3513/#3514 (the live provenance rows — one combined ~88-row reconcile is item 16 of the consolidated owner issue #3606) and #3599 (whose pre-seal truth gate takes the second census). The protocol-lever phase-class ruling is item 8 of the owner issue #3606; publishing the cycle-16 seal is item 6.

Filed from **Part 4 ("From A- to A")** of the forensic root-cause analysis of the 2026-09-05 `/review full` baseline — `docs/reviews/FORENSIC_RCA_2026-09-05.md`. This batch is the residue layer: the `every`-quantified anchor clauses whose SETS nobody enumerated, plus the per-lens residue. The 99 findings are in `docs/reviews/FULLREVIEW_2026-09-05.md` (epics #3489–#3498, stories #3499–#3571); the process layer is epics #3592/#3593 (stories #3594–#3603).

## Outcome
**Health / quantified-self enthusiasts** — The record's provenance resolves, its thresholds state where they came from, its citations are re-checked without a human, and its lever clause becomes true-or-false on Day 1 instead of vacuous.

## Acceptance
- [ ] An ABANDONED_GENESES / aliases map beside CYCLE_GENESES ({'2026-09-04': 16} with the dated reason already in the in-place-correction comment) consulted by closing_cycle_for_genesis; a restart_verify census asserts every non-null tombstoned_reason resolves to the row's own cycle stamp — RED today on 329 rows, so the positive control is free; re-putting the 329 reason strings is explicitly rejected as it destroys the record that the Friday genesis was written
- [ ] A double-reset harness runs restart_intelligence_wipe twice against a fixture table and asserts the second run mutates zero provenance fields; #3599's pre-seal truth gate takes a SECOND census after the wipe and hard-fails on any pk family present in it and absent from the first (DA-7's window: tagger 16:37Z, six INSIGHT# rows written 17:09Z)
- [ ] Every threshold in experiment_gates.py carries {value, kind: population_constant|personal_derivation, source: a citation or {metric, sd, n, window}}, surfaced in the zero-state payloads correlation_gates()/hypothesis_gates() build; a bare new literal reds a completeness test
- [ ] The citation network arm runs on a schedule (operating-calendar.yml or a nightly qa_smoke leg) with a last-success dead-man, failing on a 404, a retraction or a stored-title mismatch — silence is not a pass; the 40 supplement_registry citations and the 3 DOIs this run did not touch are in scope
- [ ] PROTOCOL# gains a `spawned_by` field (a HYPOTHESIS# id or an explicit 'pre-platform / literature' label) enforced by a write-time refusal plus a contract test over both the DDB writer and site/config/protocols.json — the clause is graded at the write, not against an empty payload
- [ ] site_api_rollups.survival derives the reported horizon from max(window_days) over priors rather than the fixed _SURVIVAL_HORIZON, so the page speaks at a horizon the record can answer, with n stated at that horizon

**Score:** P1 · Impact 4 × Confidence 1.0 / Effort M(2) = 2.00 → Now
**Epic:** #3495
title: the experiment record: threshold provenance, a scheduled citation re-resolution, a horizon the record can answer, a lever write-contract, and the abandoned genesis
